fullPassage: Hoarding disorder is a mental illness characterized by the inability to get rid of possessions that have no use or value. It is often accompanied by "excessive acquisition," which means sufferers feel the need to own as many things as possible. Hoarding behavior tends to start at an early age and becomes more and more extreme as the person grows older. Once it becomes a significant problem, it is generally treated with behavioral therapy, which helps hoarders make better decisions about keeping or getting rid of their belongings. However, as hoarding disorder can be a complex condition with multiple causes, this treatment often takes a long time, and additional methods may be required.

questions.stem: 행동 치료가 환자로 하여금 유지할지 버릴지 더 나은 결정을 내리도록 돕는 대상, 즉 그들의 무엇을 본문에서 찾아 1단어로 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: belongings = 소지품, 소유물
det.analysis: 본문 'make better decisions about keeping or getting rid of their belongings' — 환자가 유지할지 버릴지 결정하는 대상 = belongings(소지품)
det.tip: keeping or getting rid of their _____ → belongings(소지품)

questions.passage: Hoarding disorder is a mental illness characterized by the inability to get rid of possessions that have no use or value. It is often accompanied by "excessive acquisition," which means sufferers feel the need to own as many things as possible. __________ and becomes more and more extreme as the person grows older. Once it becomes a significant problem, it is generally treated with behavioral therapy, which helps hoarders make better decisions about keeping or getting rid of their belongings. However, as hoarding disorder can be a complex condition with multiple causes, this treatment often takes a long time, and additional methods may be required.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸을 완성하시오. (9단어) (영어로)
'저장 행동은 어린 나이에 시작되는 경향이 있다'
[조건] (1) age, an, at, behavior, early, Hoarding, start, tends, to를 모두 사용
(2) 9단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: Hoarding behavior tends to start at an early age = 저장 행동은 어린 나이에 시작되는 경향이 있다
det.analysis: 주어 Hoarding behavior(저장 행동)로 시작해요. '~하는 경향이 있다'는 tend to + 동사원형인데 주어가 단수라 tends to로 써요. 무엇을 하는 경향인지: to start(시작하다). 언제: at an early age(어린 나이에). 순서: Hoarding behavior + tends + to start + at an early age.
det.tip: tend to + 동사원형 = ~하는 경향이 있다 / at an early age = 어린 나이에

questions.wa: Hoarding behavior tends to start at an early age
accept: Hoarding behavior tends to start at an early age

questions.passage: Once it becomes a significant problem, it is generally treated with behavioral therapy. As hoarding disorder can be a complex condition with multiple causes, this treatment often takes a long time, and additional methods may be __________ (require).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: require(동사: 필요로 하다) → required (과거분사, 수동태: 필요로 되다). 'may be __________'는 조동사 + be + 과거분사의 수동태
det.analysis: 동사 require를 과거분사 required로 바꿔요. 'additional methods may be __________'에서 'may be' 뒤 빈칸은 수동태(조동사 + be + 과거분사)의 과거분사 자리예요. 추가적인 방법이 '필요로 되어질' 수 있다는 수동 의미라 required가 맞아요.
det.tip: may be + 과거분사 = 수동태 → may be required(필요로 될 수 있다)

questions.passage: Hoarding disorder is a mental illness characterized by the inability to get rid of possessions that have no use or value. It is often accompanied by "excessive acquisition," which means sufferers feel the need to own as many things as possible. Hoarding behavior tends to start at an early age and becomes more and more extreme as the person grows older. Once it becomes a significant problem, it is generally treated with behavioral therapy, which helps hoarders make better decisions about keeping or getting rid of their belongings. However, as hoarding disorder can be a complex condition with multiple causes, this treatment often takes a long time, and additional methods may be required.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 핵심: 저장 강박의 특징(버리지 못함·과도한 습득)과 치료(행동 치료·추가 방법)
det.analysis:
① 물건 정리법: 본문 주제가 아님
② 저장 강박 장애의 특징(버리지 못함·과도한 습득)과 행동 치료 등 치료 방법을 다루므로 주제로 가장 알맞음 ←정답
③ 수집 취미의 교육 효과: 다루지 않음
④ 식습관: 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: 글 전체 = 저장 강박의 특징 + 치료 방법

ch: 집 안 물건을 효율적으로 정리하는 방법
저장 강박 장애의 특징과 그 치료 방법
어린이의 수집 취미가 주는 교육적 효과
정신 질환을 예방하는 올바른 식습관의 중요성

questions.passage: Hoarding disorder is a mental illness characterized by the inability to get rid of possessions that have no use or value. It is often accompanied by "excessive acquisition," which means sufferers feel the need to own as many things as possible. Hoarding behavior tends to start at an early age and becomes more and more extreme as the person grows older. Once it becomes a significant problem, it is generally treated with behavioral therapy, which helps hoarders make better decisions about keeping or getting rid of their belongings. However, as hoarding disorder can be a complex condition with multiple causes, this treatment often takes a long time, and additional methods may be required.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 요지: 저장 강박은 버리지 못함·과도한 습득이 특징이며 행동 치료로 다루지만 원인이 복잡해 오래 걸린다
det.analysis:
① 나이 들면 저절로 사라짐: 본문은 나이 들수록 심해진다고 함 — 틀림
② 적게 가질수록 심해짐: 본문에 없는 내용 — 틀림
③ 버리지 못하고 과도하게 모으는 질환 + 행동 치료 + 복잡한 원인으로 오랜 치료 → 글 전체 요지 ←정답
④ 짧은 시간에 완치: 원인이 복잡해 오래 걸린다고 함 — 틀림
det.tip: 특징(버리지 못함·과도한 습득) + 치료(행동 치료) + 한계(복잡한 원인·오랜 시간) = 요지

ch: 저장 강박은 나이가 들면 저절로 사라지므로 특별한 치료가 필요 없다.
저장 강박 환자는 물건을 적게 가질수록 증상이 더 심해진다.
저장 강박은 물건을 버리지 못하고 과도하게 모으는 질환으로, 행동 치료로 다루지만 원인이 복잡해 치료에 오랜 시간이 걸린다.
행동 치료만 받으면 저장 강박은 짧은 시간 안에 완치된다.

It is often accompanied by "excessive acquisition," which means __________. Hoarding behavior tends to start at an early age and becomes more and more extreme as the person grows older. Once it becomes a significant problem, it is generally treated with behavioral therapy, which helps hoarders make better decisions about keeping or getting rid of their belongings. However, as hoarding disorder can be a complex condition with multiple causes, this treatment often takes a long time, and additional methods may be required.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸을 완성하시오. (11단어) (영어로)
'환자들은 가능한 한 많은 물건을 소유하고 싶은 욕구를 느낀다'
[조건] (1) as, as, feel, many, need, own, possible, sufferers, the, things, to를 모두 사용
(2) 11단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: sufferers feel the need to own as many things as possible = 환자들은 가능한 한 많은 물건을 소유하고 싶은 욕구를 느낀다
det.analysis: 주어는 sufferers(환자들)이고 동사는 feel(느낀다)이에요. 무엇을 느끼는지: the need(욕구). 어떤 욕구인지 to부정사로 꾸며요: to own(소유하고 싶은). 무엇을: as many things as possible(가능한 한 많은 물건). 'as many + 명사 + as possible'은 '가능한 한 많은 ~'이에요. 순서: sufferers + feel + the need + to own + as many things as possible.
det.tip: the need to + 동사원형 = ~하고 싶은 욕구 / as many things as possible = 가능한 한 많은 물건

questions.wa: sufferers feel the need to own as many things as possible
accept: sufferers feel the need to own as many things as possible
